name: send
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const f=()=>{const n=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Send assistant message"]');if(n&&!n.disabled){o.disconnect();clearTimeout(t);n.click();resolve(true)}};const o=new MutationObserver(f);o.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,attributes:true});const t=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Send unavailable')),5000);f()})
